description: Returns the live status of a tracked free API: whether the last hourly check succeeded, the measured response time, 30-day uptime, the free-tier terms, and whether an API key is required. Use this before writing code against an API to confirm it is actually alive and still free.

api.description: API slug or name, e.g. 'open-meteo', 'TMDB', 'pokeapi'. Matching is fuzzy.

name: check_api_status
title: Check whether an API is up right now
